name: maestro
description: Marketplace for the Maestro orchestrator template's own Claude Code plugins.

plugins.name: maestro
plugins.description: Skills and hooks for the Maestro orchestrator template: new-instance, maestro-sync, maestro-net between instances, satellites (project repos that borrow an instance's identity and memory), and listen (live capture of a call from any session).

plugins.name: agenda
plugins.description: A pane that shows what is left to do today: appointments with their time and open tasks, written by the orchestrator through the agenda_set tool.
